purpose: Within-world place identity across independently walked routes/headings; spatial relationships under appearance ambiguity
world_requirement: Flat open area with traversable connections; preserve diverse-v2 unchanged

appearance_control.design: Repeated local landmark layouts at distant sites; different approach context. Verify endpoint visual similarity before model evaluation.

splitting: Split full routes before window/pair construction; no shared raw frames across splits; overlapping clips remain grouped within route

evaluation.primary_pairs: Between the two held-out routes; both endpoints unseen during fit
evaluation.report: Actual site/heading occupancy and available matched near/far pairs per split before feature probing
evaluation.claim_scope: Known-site recognition across new routes/views, not extrapolation to unvisited sites

gates: Review actual first-person recordings and allocentric paths
Check accepted visits, realized positions/headings and route independence
Check ambiguity controls with endpoint images
Fit transformations on training routes; select settings using validation routes only
Freeze protocol before inspecting test features/results
not_authorized_as_completed: No new Minecraft recordings or model runs have occurred for this design

implementation.world: 49 by 49 block open field; 16 repeated floor motifs; four distant perimeter landmarks
implementation.scope: Randomized continuous scripted paths. Identical world seed/build for all six routes. Real ambiguity and rendering remain review gates.
